visual_goal: Show the nine configuration layers as a dependency graph rooted in the entity register, converging on one go-live gate through posting simulation, settlement matching and controls scoping.
prompt: A left-to-right dependency graph of rounded boxes placed on a neat grid of four rows. At the far left, a small gavel icon labeled 'Decision' with one arrow into a large box drawn with tree roots under it, labeled 'Entity register', at middle height. Top row: 'Bank accounts' in the second position only. Second row, left to right: 'Payment routes', 'Matching profile', 'Close calendar', 'Controls scoping'. Third row, left to right: 'Chart values', 'Posting rules', 'Consolidation mapping'. Fourth row: 'Tax routes' in the second position, then a gap, then 'Simulation' in the fourth position. At the far right, spanning the height, a large gate with a green light labeled 'Go-live gate'. Arrows: 'Entity register' to each of 'Bank accounts', 'Payment routes', 'Chart values' and 'Tax routes'. 'Bank accounts' down into 'Matching profile'. 'Payment routes' right to 'Matching profile'. 'Matching profile' right to 'Close calendar'. 'Close calendar' right to 'Controls scoping'. 'Controls scoping' right to 'Go-live gate'. 'Chart values' right to 'Posting rules'. 'Posting rules' diagonally up-right to 'Close calendar'. 'Posting rules' diagonally down-right to 'Simulation'. 'Chart values' to 'Consolidation mapping' by a curved arrow that dips below 'Posting rules'. 'Consolidation mapping' diagonally up-right to 'Controls scoping'. 'Tax routes' straight right along the bottom row to 'Simulation'. 'Simulation' right to 'Go-live gate'. Exactly seventeen arrows.
alt: A dependency graph rooted in the entity register: chart values, tax routes, payment routes and bank accounts feed posting rules, consolidation mapping, simulation and a matching profile, which feed the close calendar and controls scoping, all converging on one go-live gate.

visual_goal: Show the Brazil critical path: slow external items (incorporation, banking, providers, tax, regulatory opinion) dominate, while the software configuration is a short bar inside that path, so the slow items start on the day of the decision.
prompt: A horizontal timeline chart drawn as bars on a plain track, with no axis and no calendar. At the far left a vertical line topped by a gavel icon, with the date '14 Dec 2027' written directly under the gavel. At the far right a vertical line topped by a flag, with the date '1 Jul 2028' written directly under the flag. These two dates are the only words near the lines. Between them, horizontal bars that all begin at the start line: a long orange bar 'Incorporation' tagged '3 to 5 months', followed on the same row by an orange bar 'Banking' tagged '3 to 4 months', then an orange bar 'Providers' tagged '2 to 3 months', then a short orange bar 'Settlement test' reaching the finish line; these four orange bars form one thick highlighted chain. On a second row, a grey bar 'Regulatory opinion' tagged '3 to 6 months'. On a third row, a grey bar 'Tax connector' tagged '3 to 5 months'. On a fourth row, a very short blue bar 'Configuration' tagged '6 weeks', sitting small in the middle of the track to show how little time it takes.
alt: A timeline from 14 December 2027 to 1 July 2028 in which incorporation, banking, providers and a settlement test form the long critical chain, regulatory and tax work run alongside, and software configuration is a short six-week bar.

visual_goal: Show the acquired-brand timeline separating three questions: when the group can report the brand (day 1), when it can rely on its data and controls (day 100), and whether to replace its systems (a later evidence-based decision).
prompt: A horizontal timeline ribbon from left to right with milestone markers, each joined to the next by the ribbon. At the far left, a handshake marker labeled 'Deal closes' with the date '1 Sep 2027'. Next, a large marker 'Day 1' with a report document icon and a green bubble above it reading 'report'. Next, a small marker 'Day 30'. Next, a large marker 'Day 100' with a shield and checkmark icon, the date '9 Dec 2027', and a blue bubble above it reading 'rely'. Next, a small marker 'FY2028'. At the far right, a large marker 'Decision' with a balance-scale icon and an orange bubble above it reading 'replace?'. The three large markers are visibly bigger and colored, and the three bubbles stand in a row above the ribbon.
alt: A timeline from deal close on 1 September 2027 to Day 1 (report), Day 30, Day 100 on 9 December 2027 (rely), FY2028 and a later decision on whether to replace the brand's systems.
